Zatvaranje prometnica na području Grada Zagreba

description: Grad Zagreb: road datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Open Data Portal Croatia, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Grad Zagreb. Coverage: Grad Zagreb. The listing groups 6 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about road; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Geoportal Javna parkirališta za bicikle; Geoportal zone rezerviranih parkirališnih mjesta; Topografska osnova 2018. Promet; Izgrađene prometnice u Gradu Zagrebu. Formats seen: CSV, GEOJSON, KML, SHP, XLSX. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://data.gov.hr/otvorena-dozvola), as linked on the portal listing (http://www.opendefinition.org/licenses/cc-by). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-portal-otvorenih-podataka.
